feature: UEN data-quality suspension TS-ACR: UEN tidak ditemukan, firm deregistered, alamat kosong, entity name/type/status/company type code kosong
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS8.2. Selain meng-update particulars, job menahan notice company dengan TS-ACR bila data DataHive tidak lengkap atau firm sudah deregistered (storeUenDataResult, applyTSACRFor*). OCMS8.2 tidak menyebut aturan ini; mungkin dicakup story epic 8 lain (misalnya OCMS8.6-8.9 soal work item/alamat) atau epic suspension yang belum dicek.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS8.2. Besides updating particulars, the job holds a company notice with TS-ACR when the DataHive data is incomplete or the firm is deregistered (storeUenDataResult, applyTSACRFor*). OCMS8.2 does not mention these rules; they may be covered by another epic 8 story (for example OCMS8.6-8.9 on work items/addresses) or a suspension epic that was not checked.

feature: FIN tidak ditemukan di dataset DataHive: catat hasil check di ocms_dh_mha_pass dan beri TS-NRO
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS8.4. processFINNotFoundFlow menyimpan hasil 'tidak ditemukan' lalu menerapkan TS-NRO; pembuatan work item masih placeholder. Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menamainya; mungkin dicakup OCMS8.6 atau story suspension lain yang belum dicek.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS8.4. processFINNotFoundFlow stores the 'not found' outcome and then applies TS-NRO; work item creation is still a placeholder. No story in this chunk names it; it may be covered by OCMS8.6 or another suspension story that was not checked.

feature: Deteksi work permit EP/WP dan pass LTVP/STP expired/cancelled/withdrawn (hanya log, work item placeholder)
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS8.4. processEPExpiredCancelledFlow, processWPExpiredCancelledFlow, processLTVPExpiredFlow menentukan alasan pass tidak aktif lalu memanggil createWorkItemFor*, yang hanya menulis log. OCMS8.4 hanya meminta pass status diterima; tindakan atas pass expired tidak disebut. Mungkin dicakup OCMS8.6 (work item), belum dicek.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS8.4. processEPExpiredCancelledFlow, processWPExpiredCancelledFlow and processLTVPExpiredFlow work out why a pass is inactive and then call createWorkItemFor*, which only writes a log line. OCMS8.4 only asks for the pass status to be received; action on an expired pass is not mentioned. It may be covered by OCMS8.6 (work item), not checked.

feature: Penyimpanan data shareholder ACRA untuk notice company (data board sengaja tidak ditulis ke DB)
note: Ditemukan saat trace OCMS8.2. updateShareholderInfo menyimpan data shareholder dari view ACRA; penulisan board info dimatikan (komentar OCMS-DEV-2026-231). Story OCMS8.2 hanya menyebut entity name dan alamat.
note_en: Found while tracing OCMS8.2. updateShareholderInfo stores shareholder data from the ACRA views; writing of board info is switched off (comment OCMS-DEV-2026-231). Story OCMS8.2 only mentions entity name and address.
